claim: An FBI memo produced by the Bureau's Los Angeles field office in October 2020 — released as part of the Department of Justice's Epstein file production in early 2026 — recorded that a confidential human source (CHS) close to Harvard law professor Alan Dershowitz believed Jeffrey Epstein "was a co-opted Mossad agent" who had been "trained as a spy" by former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Barak. The memo is a record of a source's belief; it does not represent a corroborated FBI finding and presents no independent intelligence-community confirmation. Israeli officials and a number of ex-intelligence figures have rejected the underlying claim. The memo is, however, an FBI-generated document released by the U.S. government as part of the official Epstein production.
